description:
env_get_value (src/ir_interp/backend.rs:2389) returns env.get(..).cloned(). Every operand read of every interpreted step pays a BoundValue clone (a Vec<AnyValue> for Transport values) and the callers only borrow the result.
Sites: env_get (:2385, 43 callers funnel through it), :2521 and :3408 encode_transport_layout(&bound), :2918 encode_runtime_input_binding(&value), :1870/:1874 ProgramStep::TupleField (clones, then builds every field view to take one), :1370 BackendTail::Dispatch (inputs cloned into a Vec passed as a slice to DispatchOperands.inputs, dispatch_exec.rs:186).
Shape: return Result<&BackendBoundValue, String>; env is a separate &HashMap from everything mutated. TupleField reads one field. The Dispatch inputs change reaches dispatch_exec.rs; if it does not fall out cleanly, report it rather than force it.
Heat: per operand, per step, per transition, at program run time.

Method: .agent/strategies/ownership-shape.md. Change the signature and let cargo check enumerate dependents; resolve interleavings by compute-then-commit or a split borrow; stop and report if an Rc is the only move.
Signal: pure refactor. Full gate green; no golden, census or pin moves. Report the clone/to_vec count of each touched file before and after.
Sites were read at develop 8bf8775ae and not compiled; confirm each with cargo check before relying on it.
